notes: Compact tactical context for Claude Design tactics-tool exports - what each token DOES, not its stat sheet. units{} keyed by roster CODE, heroes{} keyed by weapon-class slug. Every field traces to source; see source.file per entry and README.md for the anti-fabrication + tag-grounding policy. Absent fields (role/positioning/doesInFight) mean the source genuinely has nothing to say there, not a generator gap.

AZA.name: Azaps
AZA.role: A mobile shielded melee that trades some defense for speed, excelling as a flanker and duelist against isolated targets.
AZA.positioning: Mobile flanker - send it around to catch isolated units or soak up burst before your main line engages.
doesInFight: Slashing-focused: slashing penetration/damage doctrines vastly outperform blunt.
Squishy without veterancy - full top tree is essential for survival at T4/T5 tier.

BER.name: Berserkers
BER.role: A mobile flanking unit with incredible damage output and sustain that can single-handedly swing fights through smart positioning and combo execution.
BER.positioning: Won't do well face to face - use as a flanking elite strike-force or special-ops unit.
doesInFight: Control Frenzy timing carefully - unit loses direct control during activation and may attack the nearest target instead of your chosen one.
The 3.08s cooldown on Berserker Assault (skill 2) drops to 2s with the unique doctrine's 20% reduction.

CLA.positioning: Approach as a flanker anchored to your team - stick with allies to apply team buffs and survive the cooldown cycle.
doesInFight: Open: X-move in, press 3 (For Freedom!) to buff yourself before taking any hits.
Combo: instantly press 2 (Claymore Strike) when in melee, let them hit once, press V (makes press 2 hit once again), into 1 (Highland...

CC.name: Companion Cavalry
CC.role: A mid-tier seasonal cavalry with a complex stacking rotation that rewards precision positioning.
CC.positioning: X-move in and position for stacking rotation. Press 3 for buffs even while hero fighting - it applies global +100 DMG stats wherever you are.
doesInFight: Optimal vs low-armor/low-HP targets: press 1 for chip DMG before the combo. For standard foes, go directly to the 2-stack.

CG.name: Condottieri Guards
CG.role: A cost-effective, forgiving shielded melee line built to charge into Shock Attack for burst damage, at its best as a flanking cleanup unit rather...
CG.positioning: Exploit the unit's speed for lateral repositioning and flanking - reposition unseen, hit targets from the rear or sides for bonus flank damage; even...
doesInFight: Alternative engagement order: move/flank first, press Shock Attack, then charge into melee once in position - lets you hit...
Cost-effective unit: sacrificing Condottieri Guards to secure map control or an objective trade is often a net win given the low leadership...

COU.name: Coutiliers
COU.role: A lancer cavalry unit that excels with zero-cooldown charge spam when stacking Mastery and the two T5 charge-reduction doctrines.
COU.positioning: Open on charge from far enough away to fully load Chargers (DMG & speed increases stack every 1.5s, 0.5s with boots rune, max 3 stacks).
doesInFight: With Mastery + the four listed charge doctrines, this unit reaches 0s charge CD - spam X-move and charge to loop.
Apply Lancer's Last Stand swap-trick: if spawned with it active, swap to another unit then back; if just lost the unit, pull from supply...

DAL.name: Dagger Axe Lancers
DAL.role: A charge cavalry unit built around Lancer's Last Stand - big flank damage once spaced correctly, but weak in a straight duel.
DAL.positioning: Go in / try to go behind the push with your hero, while the lancers stand on the opposite side of the push - they follow your hero, so send them...
doesInFight: Charge takes 1.5s to reach final stance for full damage - you have about 10s to push through a blob before skill 2 ends.
X-move and/or press 2 when the lancers are 2–3s from impact so they carry through the blob.

DA.name: Demesne Arbalists
DA.role: High per-shot crossbow damage that demands close positioning - huge drop-off means you need to be near the fight to matter, even though press-2...
DA.positioning: Huge damage drop-off - stay within brawl range to land impact; press 2 stretches reach further than the rest of the kit.
doesInFight: Never overlap Double Fire with Double Shot; fire them sequentially, one then the other.
Either Double Fire + rate-of-fire doctrine or basic rate-of-fire adds +1 shot to the spell (6→7 arrows); Bolt Penetration is equally...

FP.name: Fortebraccio Pikemen
FP.role: A strong anti-cavalry pike line that thrives in open fields when played in dispersed F1 formation.
FP.positioning: Place in F1 super-dispersed formation in open areas to maximize anti-cavalry coverage without allowing a single hero disruption to unbrace the whole...
doesInFight: The instant-brace command has a known bug: always press V (ready) before brace to mitigate it - without V, the unit often continues moving...
Use the follow-the-front-line routine: gather formation, advance (X), follow (F), press V, then brace - repeat every reposition.

HE.name: Halberd Elite
HE.role: A shield-line shredder that ignores block and demands the front lane, with the staying power to punish grouped enemies.
HE.positioning: Front lane only - low HP solo.
doesInFight: X-move in, press 2 to grab the enemy, then press 1; ability 2 resets CC and grants 30% dmg reduction.
Cloud Cleave cooldown recently buffed to 5s with +10% armour penetration.

HAL.name: Halberdiers
HAL.role: A cost-effective anti-cavalry pike unit and top-rated warband filler that deals far more damage in phalanx than most players realize, dominating once...
HAL.positioning: Pair Halberdiers with another unit that screens them from flanks - they cannot solo-hold a line.
doesInFight: Braced Halberdiers automatically face nearby enemies, reducing the need to worry about flanking or hero dives on artillery/ranged allies.
Charge ability should only be used from F1 with immediate post-hit brace; attempting it from phalanx makes the unit try to re-form...

HWA.name: Hwarang
HWA.role: A stacking ranged DPS unit that unlocks advanced abilities at 40 kills (unit or hero), then deletes at range with Arrow Rain and Artemis.
HWA.positioning: Blob formation once stacked (40 unit kills or 8 hero kills, or a mix). Reposition with Skill 2 to dodge threats.
doesInFight: Normal combo: 1 → Arrow Rain → V+Artemis → 1 (wait for each step to end). Artemis and Arrow Rain do NOT stack.

IPG.name: Imperial Pike Guards
IPG.role: A high-DPS pike line that runs over cavalry and anything charging it, trading survivability for lethality on advance-based play.

Brace (Stand Firm) works in or out of formation; Advance runs over heroes and most units, and cavalry stand almost no chance against it.

ISG.name: Imperial Spear Guards
ISG.role: A frontline shield anchor that plants under Cover Commander to soak ranged fire and melee for your team while your DPS works safely behind it.
ISG.positioning: Plant on the frontline and keep Cover Commander active to tank ranged fire and enemy melee blobs.
doesInFight: Advance is a safe approach against brace-heavy pikes like Halberdiers - it knocks them down frontally and lets you hold the line without...
After Cover Commander scatter, use Advance (once or twice quickly) to reform in tight formation, then snap back to Cover Commander within...

IR.name: Iron Reapers
IR.role: A press-one-button burst blob that cycles a CC-immune weapon-swap window and a heavy-armour damage-reduction passive to break blocking units and...

IA.name: Ironcap Archers
IA.role: A cheap filler ranged unit that lags behind meta in impact.

ISC.name: Ironcap Scout Cavalry
ISC.role: A cost-effective sword cavalry whose core damage engine is the X-move during Sprint, not Charge.

IS.name: Ironcap Swordsmen
IS.role: A cheap charge-cycling unit that trades sustained melee for devastating charge damage and burst CC potential.
IS.positioning: Bait or position enemies into a charge vector; charge into the back of a unit or into heroes for burst kills.
doesInFight: Charge-cycle playstyle: charge, disengage, reset (~12-second cooldown), charge again.
Never stay in prolonged open melee against stronger units - this unit's value is almost entirely in the charge itself.

JS.name: Javelin Sergeants
JS.role: A backline javelin-thrower with exceptional hero-kill potential and poke pressure on grouped enemies.
JS.positioning: Backline thrower, never lead or enter melee.
doesInFight: Two targets pierced per javelin (vs Imperial Javelins' single hit), making Sergeants superior against grouped/stacked enemies.
AoE throw (ability 1) into targeted throw (ability 3) is the core combo - tag spread groups with AoE, then immediate targeted follow-up for...

LAN.name: Lancastrian Billmen
LAN.role: A bracing bill/pike line that leans on heavy bleed damage and eats cavalry charges when held still.
LAN.positioning: Play like any pikes - hold formation around your Stalwart or current-meta shield, and be braced before cavalry arrives.

LR.name: Liaos Rangers
LR.role: A top flank cavalry that clears with heavy mace bursts and cleans up isolated targets better than almost anything else in the class.
LR.positioning: Engage with spell 1 from mid-close range.
doesInFight: Movement speed leverages damage, but entering a blob at very low speed can be better when enemy pikes are present - their damage buff from...
Recent spell-2 delay nerf still permits engagement but reduces skirmish and duelling power notably.

LC.name: Lionroar Crew
LC.role: A slow, high-impact exotic unit that places deployable cannons to control objectives and deny enemy positioning.
LC.positioning: Protect the crew - keep it behind your frontline, especially when cannons are deployed.

Pair with other units for protection; it alone will not survive focused fire.

QK.name: Queens Knights

RL.role: A standard backline archer whose press-1 arrow spell carries the whole kit - no unusual mechanics, no documented gimmick.

doesInFight: Less value on Artemis and Arrow Rain than a typical archer build, since the Longbow carries its own arrow-rain-like spell.

SG.role: A grenade-delivery unit rather than a shooter - its whole value is one well-timed spell-2 throw into a blobbed enemy, not its rifles.

Spear→sword after any hit: +500 Piercing/Slashing Armour Penetration per soldier for 10s.

Sideways Sweep and Deathstrike both last 6s; do not cancel them early.

SC.name: Spartan Chosen
SC.role: A heavily armored shield-wall anchor that thrives in blob and skirmish but crumbles to huge burst damage from units like Iron Reapers, Claymores, or...

Ability 2 (shield advance) requires re-pressing during the advance to stab; the 3rd press jumps forward with big damage.

SUN.role: A premier point-holder that deletes cavalry and anything without block the moment it braces.
SUN.positioning: Sit one pike-length behind your front line and control distance - never lead with it; set brace range accounting for enemy long pikes.

TLC.name: Tiger and Leopard Cavalry
TLC.role: A newly-buffed elite lancer cavalry that stacks passive damage the longer it charges.

Ability rotation: press 1 (simple charge) → 2 (area impact, similar to Liaos or Kheshig) → 3 (crowd control cleanse and charge again)...

longsword.role: Tank - no other viable play styles.
longsword.positioning: Go first in, frontline, in any push or defence - it's Longsword's role to pull enemy and unit attention while pushing forward 24/7. - house playbook
doesInFight: You're faster than you look: you move at ordinary speed even while blocking with right click, and 20% faster for 10s after using a skill...
Mercy of Heaven is your sustain tool: time the heal to land on your frontline at crucial moments, not on cooldown.

maul.name: Maul
maul.role: Maul is a bruiser class offering mobility and constant DPS/high burst depending on build.
maul.positioning: Maelstrom and the dive combo point at flanking/backline dives (arty, exotics, isolated pike), not static frontline holding.
doesInFight: Core skill expression is the dash-auto-attack-animation-cancel loop (auto-attack, side-roll the instant the damage number pops, repeat)...
Mountain Breaker and Mighty Mjölnir both grant a 26% buff to whatever's combo'd after them - plan the rotation around this.

musket.name: Musket
musket.role: Support an assault or bolster a defence!
musket.positioning: If you're in position to hit an enemy hero at all (meaning you are in main push for some reason) you are doing something wrong anyway as you should...

nodachi.name: Nodachi
nodachi.role: The nodachi is a large two-handed sword that excels at cutting down lightly protected units.
nodachi.positioning: Fight to the sides or behind your own units, using Tiger's Claw/Avalanche/Fearless & Steadfast from that position rather than out in the open.
doesInFight: Bloodthirsty is "the near mandatory skill for nodachi users" - mobility, a control effect, and a control-effect removal in one low-cooldown...

pike.name: Pike
pike.role: Pike users are extremely maneuverable and chain low cooldown skills to outfight the enemy.
pike.positioning: Hero-duel and pick class first, anti-unit second - less effective against enemy units than most other weapon classes, so don't try to anchor a line...
doesInFight: Passive: using skills can stack buffs and change the effects of other skills - normal attacks add a Strong as a Storm effect, increasing...
Use your dismount to stun hero's mix in auto attacks into your combos roll and block to cancel animations and never be stationary as pike.

poleaxe.name: Poleaxe
poleaxe.role: The poleaxe is a two-handed polearm focused around dealing large amounts of control effects against both units and heroes.
poleaxe.positioning: Tank anchor for Longsword: Poleaxe is one of the two named tank anchor classes a Longsword player pairs with to absorb and pull focus.
doesInFight: Pushback: instantly removes you from CC while stunning enemies hit - a crucial survival and disruption tool.
Block stops almost everything: Poleaxe's entire kit of CC skills --except pin--, per BirdOfQin's active-blocking rundown. "Pin" isn't a...

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.role: The Shortbow in Conqueror's Blade is a nimble ranged Hero class which shines in close-to-mid range combat.
shortbow.positioning: Optimal range: fight around a ~5-10 meter sweet spot - inside ~5m you risk getting melee'd, beyond ~10-15m your damage/accuracy fall off.
doesInFight: Damage profile: poison-mark-then-AA-detonate can hit any target for -40% to -60% of their HP, but kills get harder to close out as the...
Angry Hornets has a wide splash - don't fire it at a target that hasn't closed distance yet, or the spread is wasted.

shortsword.name: Shortsword
shortsword.role: Shortsword is a brawler class focused on tanking and disruption.
shortsword.positioning: Frontline, inside the fight - absorb damage, disrupt, make them waste effort killing you.
doesInFight: Disruption and pressure over damage; create chaos, let units take the kills.
Shielded Charge is the mobility tool - engage, catch, or escape; don't burn it without a plan.

spear.name: Spear
spear.role: Spear users have excellent mounted attack capabilities and the ability to deal great burst damage to enemy heroes.
spear.positioning: Look for undefended prey; poke from horseback to bait cooldowns before committing to a dismount engage.
doesInFight: Piercing Damage is the top-priority weapon stat - "like oxygen, maximize this".
Assisted Aiming on Hero is a deliberate tradeoff, not a strict upgrade.

spear-and-shield.name: Spear & Shield
spear-and-shield.role: The Shield & Spear excels at both defensive maneuvers and aggressive counter-offensives.
spear-and-shield.positioning: Front-lane, CC heroes and units on cooldown - use sidesteps to cut through units any time you need to chase a hero or exotic unit.
doesInFight: Weapon-stat priority: Blunt DMG&Pen leads the bonus list ahead of raw STR/AGI - denetax.fr flips this to Blunt as the MAIN stat instead
Crit Value is a weak stat here: you already sit at 100% crit rate on your main dps spell (not named by Amya).
